parameters.content:
Workflow 2: Client Booked → Onboarding Chain

Purpose: Fires when a client books their kickoff call, sets up everything needed to start their engagement, project, folders, team assignment, and confirmation, then marks onboarding complete.

Logic:

Cal.com webhook fires on booking
Finds matching client record (by email + Status = "New Lead," to correctly target the right engagement if a client has multiple)
Updates Status → "Booked," logs Booking Date/Time
Creates Asana project, stores project ID back in Airtable

Account Manager (always assigned, once per client):
→ Round-robin picks least-busy Account Manager, creates Asana task, logs activity

Client Drive folder:
→ Reuses existing folder if client has one (returning client), otherwise creates fresh

Per-service loop (Design and/or Development, based on client's selection):
→ Loop processes one service at a time to avoid item-matching ambiguity
→ For each: finds or creates the persistent service folder (e.g. "Design"), creates a unique "- [Asana ID]" subfolder for this specific engagement, assigns the relevant team member (Designer/Developer) via round-robin, logs activity

Once all services processed: sends final onboarding email, then updates Status → "Onboarded"

Resilience: key external API nodes (Asana, Google Drive, Gmail) have Retry On Fail enabled to recover from brief hiccups automatically. Any unrecoverable failure triggers Workflow 3 (Error Handler) via Slack.

Known limitation: if a client somehow has two simultaneous unbooked engagements, the email+status match could update the wrong one. Production fix would pass a unique record ID through the booking link.

Depends on: Airtable (Clients, Team, Activity Log), Asana, Google Drive, Cal.com webhook, Gmail, Slack
